surfaces.label: DNS-pinned HTTP retrieval and cache
surfaces.notes: Validated addresses are bound to connections; redirects and cache hits revalidate transport policy.

surfaces.label: Strict JSON and resource limits
surfaces.notes: Duplicate keys, depth, node, byte, cycle, sparse-array, and non-JSON checks are covered.

surfaces.label: Delegation and final-URL authority
surfaces.notes: Observed final URL, descriptor, scope, subject, time, revocation, and key allowlist checks are shared.

surfaces.label: Detached signature metadata and cryptographic verification
surfaces.notes: RC3 structured protected metadata and sidecar lifetime binding are fail-closed.

surfaces.label: Validator structural and semantic input boundary
surfaces.notes: Runtime and graph inputs are bounded and normalized before schema and semantic processing.

surfaces.label: Generator source/output ownership and atomic replacement
surfaces.notes: Approved roots, markers, mode selectors, dependency closure, symlink checks, locks, journals, and rollback reviewed.

surfaces.label: Release archive traversal and reproducibility
surfaces.notes: Excluded dependency trees are pruned before traversal; isolated temporary output roots are trusted only after safe-root validation.

surfaces.label: CLI path, graph, and dry-run boundaries
surfaces.notes: CLI paths and report writes use bounded and symlink-aware operations.

surfaces.label: Browser engine, uploads, URL service, CSP/XSS
surfaces.notes: Browser JSON/YAML is bounded and normalized; report output uses textContent; service requests are same-origin HTTPS-bound.

surfaces.label: Package exports and clean tarball installation
surfaces.notes: Exports target dist and clean package runtime/type smoke checks passed.

surfaces.label: Traceability and aggregate verification evidence
surfaces.notes: Evidence records require formal zero-finding scan, exact source-tree agreement, and an authoritative self-check.

surfaces.label: CI, security policy, and dependency controls
surfaces.notes: Action pins, policy/security checks, lint, dependency audit, and license checks passed locally where available.
